title: Aldous Huxley takes a high dose of LSD while dying

tellings.quote: >> he I think at the end of his life was uh was dying and he asked his wife to uh give him an extremely high dose of LSD.

plain: The writer Aldous Huxley, as he lay dying in 1963, is said to have asked his wife to give him an extremely high dose of LSD. Michels tells this himself, as something he believes he remembers, in a conversation about psychedelic drugs with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore. He brings it up as an example of someone choosing to meet death through a psychedelic experience.
